issue: The unit-tested `RollbackController` (debounce >=2 consecutive FAIL, flap-guard verifying the restore target itself passes before restoring, one-Telegram-per-incident dedup — apps/life-call/lib/money-path.js:38-67, PASSed iteration-2 review) is NOT wired into the actual production rollback path. The real GHA step (netlify-deploy.yml:74-97) and `apps/landing/scripts/money-path-smoke.mjs` reimplement a separate, materially weaker check that: (1) rolls back on a SINGLE fail with only a fixed `sleep 20` for CDN propagation and no retry/debounce, so CDN-propagation flakiness can roll back a perfectly GOOD deploy; (2) picks the previous ready deploy (`a[1]`) and calls `/restore` WITHOUT ever verifying that deploy itself still passes the money-path check (no flap guard) — if the previous deploy was also broken, the workflow silently 'restores' into another broken deploy and reports success; (3) sends no Telegram/escalation notification at all. Additionally, C6's explicit standalone requirement — 'the 15-min money-path monitor runs as a GitHub Actions scheduled workflow (independent of Railway/Netlify)' (Goal-5) — does not exist anywhere; `.github/workflows/` contains only this one push-triggered post-deploy smoke, so a money-path break introduced between deploys (Stripe-side change, external tampering, delayed CDN divergence) is never detected or auto-healed.
evidence: grep -r 'require(.*money-path|RollbackController|assertMoneyPath' repo-wide (excluding node_modules) → matches only apps/life-call/lib/money-path.js and apps/life-call/lib/money-path.test.js; apps/landing/scripts/money-path-smoke.mjs has zero import of lib/money-path.js (confirmed by direct Read: it defines its own inline `fail()`/`get()`/STRIPE_RE logic). netlify-deploy.yml:87-89's PREV-selection code has no verification step calling money-path-smoke.mjs (or any check) against the restored deploy's URL before/after `/restore`. `.github/workflows/*.yml` Glob returns only `netlify-deploy.yml` — no `schedule:`-triggered monitor workflow exists.
fix: Either (a) port RollbackController's debounce+flap-guard+dedup state machine into the GHA workflow (persist state via a repo artifact or external KV so it survives across workflow runs) and re-verify the restore target with money-path-smoke.mjs before treating a rollback as successful, or (b) delete the dead money-path.js state machine and explicitly document why the simpler one-shot post-deploy gate is sufficient. Separately, stand up the C6-required standalone `schedule:`-triggered 15-min monitor workflow — Goal-5 is currently entirely unimplemented outside of a deploy event.
